name: Zip
author: Rich Geldreich and contributors (miniz)
description: Create, list and extract .zip archives from the Terminal. Type zip archive.zip file1 file2 to create, zip -l archive.zip to list contents, zip -x archive.zip [dir] to extract.

descriptions.en: Create, list and extract .zip archives from the Terminal. Type zip archive.zip file1 file2 to create, zip -l archive.zip to list contents, zip -x archive.zip [dir] to extract.
descriptions.it: Crea, elenca ed estrae archivi .zip dal Terminale. Scrivi zip archivio.zip file1 file2 per creare, zip -l archivio.zip per l'elenco, zip -x archivio.zip [cartella] per estrarre.
